decisions.reason: The source changes only the referral-code mint-success modal copy; the About-page content remains valid unchanged.
The source specifies post-mint modal wording and does not alter the landing-page hero copy or layout.
The mint-success modal is distinct from the NFT certificate and read-link email, whose contents remain unchanged.
The new modal wording does not change how fiat buyers access wallets, commissions, tickets, prizes, or dashboard information.
Mentioning a $5 commission and prize ticket in confirmation copy does not change the existing primary-sale allocation.
The source does not change the $15 mint price, pricing conditions, or advertised price commitment.
The source defines confirmation copy for code-based mints and does not alter the Transak provider or fiat-mint flow.
The source does not change background wallet creation, custody, key control, or seed-phrase requirements.
The candidate governs pre-mint valid or invalid referral feedback, while the source changes a separate post-mint success message.
The modal copy describes the already-established $5 payment to the selected NFT holder but does not change commission amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or delivery.
Changing success-modal wording does not alter the NFT ebook product type or unlimited-mint supply model.
The referral-specific success message does not alter optional tipping, tip amounts, or the separate post-mint tip transaction.
